description: Create a designLibraryStore (Zustand) that fetches ACTIVE templates with availability calculation, design family grouping, search/filter capabilities, and template detail/preview support. This store replaces the simple fetchAvailableTemplates in projectCreationStore for the Design Library UI.
steps: Create frontend/src/stores/designLibraryStore.ts with a Zustand store that: (a) fetches all ACTIVE templates from perfecity.template, (b) joins with design_family_master to get design family names, (c) checks template_zone_sku -> sku_master status and catalogue_entry status to compute availability (AVAILABLE if all zone SKUs are ACTIVE with catalogue READY, BLOCKED otherwise), (d) stores blocked reasons per template

Add state fields: templates (with availability info), filteredTemplates, designFamilies (from design_family_master), filters (search text, design_family_id, wall_geometry, availability status), selectedTemplateDetail (for preview), isLoading, error

Add actions: fetchTemplatesWithAvailability(), setSearchFilter(text), setDesignFamilyFilter(id|null), setWallGeometryFilter(type|null), setAvailabilityFilter('ALL'|'AVAILABLE'|'BLOCKED'), selectTemplateForPreview(template), clearPreview(), groupByDesignFamily() helper that returns Map<string, Template[]>

The availability check logic: for each ACTIVE template, query template_zone -> template_zone_sku -> sku_master (check status=ACTIVE) and catalogue_entry (check status=READY). If any SKU is INACTIVE or catalogue not READY, template is BLOCKED with reasons array listing which SKUs/entries failed
Add a TemplateWithAvailability type: extends Template with availability: 'AVAILABLE' | 'BLOCKED', blockedReasons: string[], designFamilyName: string | null

Ensure the store filters work client-side after initial fetch (like templateManagementStore pattern) - filter by search (name/description match), design family, wall geometry type, and availability status
Export the store and types from frontend/src/stores/index.ts if an index exists, otherwise just export from the store file
acceptance_criteria: designLibraryStore exports useDesignLibraryStore with all state fields and actions
TemplateWithAvailability type is exported and includes availability, blockedReasons, designFamilyName fields
fetchTemplatesWithAvailability fetches ACTIVE templates and computes availability per template
Filter actions update filteredTemplates client-side matching search, designFamily, wallGeometry, availability
groupByDesignFamily returns templates grouped by design family name
TypeScript compiles without errors (npm run typecheck passes)
verification: cd frontend && NODE_OPTIONS="" npx vitest run
findings: Pre-existing TS error in ValidationOverlayLayer.tsx (unused variable errorCount) unrelated to this feature. All 1144 unit tests pass. E2E tests skipped (no SUPABASE_URL env var as documented). Build succeeds. The store staged with task-wall-zone-ui-optimization files that were in git index.
